meta.title: The Toolbox That Got Sorted
meta.skill_frame: Find the main idea: decide what a passage is mostly about.

reader.who: Older students who read at about a third-grade level.
reader.why_this_level: The load is one change and one result. The passage keeps returning to order and time. Measured FK 2.1-2.9 on the two parts (Flesch-Kincaid, approximate syllable count). The reading load sits inside the grade 2-3 band and below the 4.1 floor, which measures 5.3 at its easiest.
reader.tone: Adult subject. Plain sentences. The lesson must not make the reader feel small.

source.attribution: Original text drafted for main_idea 3.1, band 3.1, sequence 4. No external work.
source.survey: Written to the floor: short sentences, everyday words, one or two links.
source.avoided: No childish subject. No talking down. No invented facts about real named places.

session.difficulty_basis: Clue distance and number of links, climbing one knob per sequence.

authoring_exceptions: Parts run 55-85 words instead of 100-200. At band 3.1 the text is short by design: two parts keep the session inside 12 minutes and the load stays at one or two links. Recorded under 2.1.

script_overrides.near_copy_2: Say it in your own words. One sentence is enough.

passage.part_1: My uncle keeps one toolbox for the whole shop. For years it was a pile, and he could not find a bit without moving six things first. In the spring he put four small trays inside it. Each tray holds one kind of tool. Bits in one, drivers in another, pliers in a third, and the tape in the last.
passage.part_2: The box is heavier now, and it is still one box. He still carries it to the bench the same way. What changed is the time, because a job that took two trips now takes one. He has not bought a new tool since spring. He says the box did not get better, and the order did.

items.prompt: What is the first part mostly about?

tutor_only.confirm: Right. The toolbox was a mess, and he put in trays to sort it.
tutor_only.correct_reason: The first part gives the old pile, the trouble finding things, and the four new trays.
tutor_only.tell: The first part is about the toolbox getting sorted into trays.
help: Look at what the box was like before and what he added.
tutor_only.core_idea: The toolbox was a pile, and he added four trays to sort it.
accept_ideas: he sorted the toolbox with trays
he fixed the mess with four trays

if_they_say.when: the student says it is about buying tools
if_they_say.ask: The passage says he has not bought a tool since spring. What is the part about?

items.prompt: What is the second part mostly about?

tutor_only.confirm: Yes. The sorting saved time, not space.
tutor_only.correct_reason: The second part says the box is heavier and still one box, then names time as the change.
tutor_only.tell: The second part is about what actually improved: the time a job takes.
help: Look at what the passage says changed.
The weight went up. What went down?
tutor_only.core_idea: Sorting saved time, though the box did not get smaller or lighter.
accept_ideas: the time it takes got shorter

if_they_say.when: the student says the box got lighter
if_they_say.ask: The passage says it is heavier. What changed?

items.prompt: What is the whole passage mostly about?

tutor_only.confirm: Right. Putting tools in order made the same box work better.
tutor_only.correct_reason: Both parts serve one idea: order changed the work, not the tools or the box.
tutor_only.tell: Sorting one box made the same tools faster to find and use.
help: Both parts are about the same change to one box.
The passage names what got better and what did not.
tutor_only.core_idea: Sorting the tools made the same box faster to use.
accept_ideas: sorting the box made it better
order made the box work better
he sorted his tools and saved time
the order helped, not the box

if_they_say.when: the student says it is about buying a new box
if_they_say.ask: He bought no new box. What changed?

items.prompt: How many trays did he put in?

tutor_only.correct_reason: The sentence says four small trays.
tutor_only.tell: He added four trays, one for each kind of tool.
help: Find the sentence with the number.

if_they_say.ask: Six was the number of things he had to move before. How many trays?

items.prompt: The passage says the box is heavier now. Is that the main idea? Explain.

tutor_only.confirm: Right. It is a detail about what did not improve.
tutor_only.correct_reason: The weight sentence sets up the point that order, not the box, is what changed.
tutor_only.tell: One sentence about weight supports the idea. It is not the idea.
help: Think about why the writer mentions the weight.
If weight went up and time went down, what is the passage about?
tutor_only.core_idea: No. It is a detail showing the box itself did not get better.
accept_ideas: no, the main idea is the order
no, it shows the box did not improve
not_required: what the box is made of

if_they_say.when: the student says yes because the weight changed
if_they_say.ask: The weight is one detail. What is the whole passage about?
